canonical.title: A Basel weekend, dinner-first: how the three angles dovetail

siblings.title: Things to do in Basel
siblings.summary: A weekend in Basel splits cleanly into a museum half-day, a Rhine swim with the Wickelfisch, and an Old Town walk — your hotel's BaselCard covers all of it.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Basel
siblings.summary: Three top-starred restaurants in Basel — Cheval Blanc (3★, La Liste #1), Roots (2★, plant-forward), Stucki (2★, closing Sept 2026 for renovation). How to choose.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Basel
siblings.summary: Basel's tech calendar is bimodal — life-sciences mega-events at Messe and one pure-developer flagship (BaselOne in October), with a thin layer of monthly meetups.

sources.title: Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl — Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois
sources.claim: Cheval Blanc — 3 Michelin stars, 19 GaultMillau, La Liste #1; closed 1–24 Aug and 20–26 Dec 2026; dress code (long sleeves/trousers for men).

sources.title: Roots — Pascal Steffen
sources.claim: Roots — 2 Michelin stars, vegetable-forward; Tue–Sat 18:30+, Thu lunch, Sun/Mon closed.

sources.title: Stucki – Tanja Grandits (Michelin Guide)
sources.claim: Stucki – Tanja Grandits — Two Stars; Bruderholzallee 42.

sources.title: Vitra Campus via Basel tram 8 (Basel Tourism)
sources.claim: Basel tram 8 from Basel SBB / Barfüsserplatz / Claraplatz to Weil am Rhein, 10-min walk to Vitra Campus.

sources.title: BaselCard (Basel Tourism)
sources.claim: BaselCard, free with overnight booking, covers second-class public transport in TNW zones 10/11/13/14/15 for the entire stay (up to 30 days) plus 25% off museums, zoo and Theater Basel.

sources.title: Stucki schliesst temporär — Tanja Grandits plant grossen Umbau (Falstaff)
sources.claim: Stucki closes 26 September 2026; 'Tanja am Rhy' interim opens 1 February 2027; Bruderholz reopens November 2027.

sources.title: Lunch costs CHF 900 at Basel's La Liste #1 (Bluewin)
sources.claim: Cheval Blanc lunch for two reported at ~CHF 900 in Swiss news coverage of the La Liste #1 tie.

sources.title: Best fine-dining in Basel (Swiss Traveler)
sources.claim: Stucki business lunch CHF 95–140; 9-course Aroma menu CHF 265; vegetarian parallel menu.

sources.title: Swimming in the Rhine (Basel Tourism)
sources.claim: Rhine swimming is Basel's most popular summer sport; safest entry just below Museum Tinguely, ~3 km float, stay close to the Kleinbasel bank.

sources.title: Plan your visit (Kunstmuseum Basel)
sources.claim: Kunstmuseum Basel adult admission CHF 30; collection free every first Sunday of the month.

sources.title: BaselOne 2026 (official)
sources.claim: BaselOne 2026 — independent software dev conference, 14–15 Oct at Markthalle Basel.

sources.title: health.tech global summit (official)
sources.claim: health.tech runs 3–5 March 2026 at Messe Basel; 5,000+ delegates; MCH Group × Bits & Pretzels.

sources.title: Rhine water temperature in Basel (SeaTemperature)
sources.claim: Rhine water in Basel typically 20–25 °C (68–77 °F) July/August.

sources.title: Imagine Festival Basel (official)
sources.claim: Imagine Festival 2026 — 5–6 June, Barfüsserplatz + Klosterhof, free.

sources.title: Basel Tattoo (official)
sources.claim: Basel Tattoo 20th anniversary edition: 17–25 July 2026 at Kaserne Basel.

sources.title: Allianz Cinema Basel (official)
sources.claim: Allianz Cinema Basel: 30 July – 25 August 2026 on Münsterplatz.

sources.title: Em Bebbi sy Jazz (official)
sources.claim: Em Bebbi sy Jazz: Friday 14 August 2026, ~70 bands across ~30 venues, free.

sources.title: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2025 (official)
sources.claim: Michelin Switzerland 2025: 145 starred restaurants — 114 one-star, 27 two-star, 4 three-star.

sources.title: Fondation Beyeler — visit (official)
sources.claim: Fondation Beyeler open daily 10–18 (Wed until 20), 365 days; adult CHF 25 (Tue CHF 20), under 25 free.

sources.title: Fondation Beyeler (official)
sources.claim: Renzo Piano–designed museum with 400+ modern/contemporary works in a park with sculptures and water-lily ponds.

sources.title: Vitra Campus (official)
sources.claim: Vitra Campus in Weil am Rhein — buildings by Gehry, Hadid, Ando, Herzog & de Meuron, SANAA on one site.

sources.title: Markthalle Basel (Basel Tourism)
sources.claim: Markthalle Basel — international food hall near main station, 25–30 stalls and bars under one historic roof.

sources.title: Wickelfisch rental (Basel Tourism)
sources.claim: Wickelfisch L bag rentable from Tourist Info CHF 10/day + CHF 30 deposit, June–September.

sources.title: Official Basel Rhine Swim (city of Basel)
sources.claim: Basel's annual mass-participation Rhine float: 11 August 2026.

sources.title: Basel Minster (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: Basel Münster — built 1019–1500, red sandstone Romanesque-Gothic, main landmark of Basel.

sources.title: Visiting Basler Münster (European Traveler)
sources.claim: Münster open summer daily 10–17 (winter 11–16; Sun from ~11:30), free entry, CHF 6 to climb towers.

sources.title: Pfalz viewpoint behind the Münster (Explorial)
sources.claim: Pfalz terrace behind the Münster — free, 24/7-accessible viewpoint over the Rhine to Kleinbasel, Black Forest and Vosges.

sources.title: Middle Bridge, Basel (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: Mittlere Brücke — oldest existing bridge site across the Rhine between Lake Constance and the North Sea; current 192 m granite span unveiled 11 November 1905.

sources.title: Basel's Rhine reaction ferries (MySwitzerland)
sources.claim: Four cable-pulled reaction ferries (Wilde Maa, Leu, Vogel Gryff, Ueli) cross Grossbasel ↔ Kleinbasel May–October.

sources.title: Buvette on the Kleinbasel Rhine (Basel Tourism)
sources.claim: Kaserne-side Buvette on the Kleinbasel Rhine promenade — March to October, sunset spritzes.

sources.title: Kunstmuseum Basel (official)
sources.claim: World's oldest public art collection; three central venues (Hauptbau, Neubau, Gegenwart).

sources.title: Museum Tinguely — on view (official)
sources.claim: Museum Tinguely summer 2026: Angelica Mesiti 'Reverb', 'Labouring Bodies', Nicolas Darrot 'Fuzzy Logic'.

sources.title: Vitra Design Museum (official)
sources.claim: Vitra Design Museum in Weil am Rhein — daily 10–18; combined Design Museum + Schaudepot ticket €23.

sources.title: Augusta Raurica (official)
sources.claim: Augusta Raurica open-air site — free admission; March to October open daily 10:00–17:00.

sources.title: Augusta Raurica (Lonely Planet)
sources.claim: Switzerland's largest Roman ruins, 17 km east of Basel — S1 to Kaiseraugst (11 min, CHF 3.80) + 10-min walk.

sources.title: Art Basel 2026 dates (Europe Highlight)
sources.claim: Art Basel 2026 runs 18–21 June at Messe Basel; VIP preview days 16–17 June.

sources.title: Bar Rouge — about (official)
sources.claim: Bar Rouge — 31st floor of Messeturm, 105m up, club Thu–Sat.

sources.title: Volkshaus Basel — brasserie (official)
sources.claim: Volkshaus Basel — Herzog & de Meuron-designed brasserie in Kleinbasel under chef Benjamin Mohr.
